[LCSP.2.2] **Bounded steady-state memory.** Total memory consumption
after the integrator sizes the pools is a function of the supplied
caps (WM, agenda, token pool, intern, intern bytes, cache keys +
bytes) and the DSC's schema/rule structure. No runtime growth. The
cache is engine state ([LSTO.4.7]); it joins the slab
budget like the other pools, so a bounded-memory program bounds it
too. Its caps come from the integrator's boot-time pool sizing, like the
other caps ([LCSP.3.4]).
